selection.selection_basis: one supervisor-authorized matched triplet; original canonical AB only; no outcome selection

cast_sequence: hn=sqrt(fsum(float64(h0_j)*float64(h0_j))); offset_j=float32(float64(hn*serialized_w_j)); hidden_j=float32(h0_j+offset_j); every call starts at original prompt; no sign/strength/renormalization/projection
interpretation: oracle execution diagnostic on three related non-text-equivalent situations in two mappings; nonself baseline preservation is not ordinary-task accuracy
coverage_policy: eligibility: original eligible baseline A with requested B, or B with requested A; achieved: eligible original edit strictly accepted with requested full argmax; also report all actual argmax flips separately. Missing coverage is unresolved, never a new acceptance gate or permission for baseline search.

diagnostic_goals.rule: G_i=max(.10,fresh self S0_i); self rows only
diagnostic_goals.membership: self baseline full-vocabulary argmax already PRESERVE
diagnostic_goals.freeze_time: after all six eligible baselines, durable self goals before any edit
diagnostic_goals.acceptance_role: auxiliary only; not an oracle-plumbing gate

prelaunch.policy: one model-free post-lock check before worker; no resume/read retry/permissions or Git repair

baseline_policy: all six own fresh finite A/B fullargmax; mass>=.80 and abs(S0)>=.05; no archived-state equality gate or reuse
routing_policy: trusted category metadata only; unknown/missing category error in every mode; baseline OFF; oracle fixed table; forced_on only four nonself; identical model input in all modes

input_policy.prospective_lock: exact prompt bytes plus pinned tokenizer/template/revision and code; no tokenizer load before source/input lock
input_policy.realized_lock: durable all-six encoded token IDs and native absent mask before first forward; independently compare every actual model input; no prompt suffix or gate decision
